core_gates: Generator may propose options but cannot select actions.
Selector receives only admitted anonymous CandidateOptions.
Natural-language descriptions must not be selector-visible.
Semantic labels must not be selector-visible.
Every admitted option must have lineage and evidence support.
Generated options must carry uncertainty when evidence is weak.
Replay must reconstruct the option set and distribution.
RAG / heuristic / generator baselines must receive equivalent allowed inputs.
Outcome updates must affect future generated option admission or scoring.
Retired options must be traceable and reversible.
